facts.fact: Revenue Services Lesotho says taxpayers can pay tax by mobile money (EcoCash and M-Pesa) through its e-Payments platform.

Revenue Services Lesotho says taxes can be paid electronically through its e-Payments platform by mobile money (EcoCash, M-Pesa) and by bank EFT, including Standard Lesotho Bank's UNAYO, whose payments show instantly in the RSL system.
Revenue Services Lesotho says taxpayers register on its eTax platform, log in with a username and password and file their returns there.
Revenue Services Lesotho says taxes can be paid through its e-Payments platform by mobile money and by bank electronic transfer.

Revenue Services Lesotho says individual taxpayers can register online through eTax to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number, while companies obtain the TIN from RSL after registering with the relevant ministries.
